summary.text: Aicha Davis is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 109 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Texas State Board of Education from 2019 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Aicha Davis served on the Texas State Board of Education, District 13, from 2019 to 2024, succeeding Erika Beltran, a Democrat.
She assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Carl Sherman Sr., a Democrat.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 109 on March 3, 2026.
